text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen is on the horizon and Manhattan Cafe is trying to turn over a new leaf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm certain her efforts to recover are thanks to our bond—a bond that has only deepened since the incident at the airport.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Manhattan Cafe's growth, Agnes Tachyon is just as eager for her to transcend her limits and cross over into unknown frontiers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our rival today is Silence Suzuka. Can Manhattan Cafe overcome both her and her friend?
